241class FReflectionEnvironmentCubemapArray : public FRenderResource
242{
243public:

245 FReflectionEnvironmentCubemapArray(ERHIFeatureLevel::Type InFeatureLevel)
246 : FRenderResource(InFeatureLevel)

248 , NumReservedCubemaps(0)

252 virtual void InitRHI(FRHICommandListBase& RHICmdList) override;
253 virtual void ReleaseRHI() override;
254
261 void UpdateMaxCubemaps(uint32 InMaxCubemaps, uint32 InNumReserved, int32 CubemapSize);
262
269 void ResizeCubemapArrayGPU(uint32 InMaxCubemaps, uint32 InNumReserved, int32 CubemapSize, const TArray<int32>& IndexRemapping, const TArray<int32>& ReservedTailRemapping);
270
271 int32 GetMaxCubemaps() const { return MaxCubemaps; }
272 int32 GetMaxRegularCubemaps() const { return (int32)MaxCubemaps - (int32)NumReservedCubemaps; }
273 int32 GetNumReservedCubemaps() const { return (int32)NumReservedCubemaps; }
274 int32 GetCubemapSize() const { return CubemapSize; }
275 bool IsValid() const { return IsValidRef(ReflectionEnvs); }
276 const TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget>& GetRenderTarget() const { return ReflectionEnvs; }
277 void Reset();
278
279protected:
280 uint32 MaxCubemaps;
281
282 // Number of slots at the tail of the cubemap array reserved as RuntimeRefreshBlendSlots blend sources.
283 // Regular capture allocations live in [0, MaxCubemaps - NumReservedCubemaps); the reserved tail occupies
284 // [MaxCubemaps - NumReservedCubemaps, MaxCubemaps).
285 uint32 NumReservedCubemaps;
286
287 int32 CubemapSize;
288 TRefCountPtr<IPooledRenderTarget> ReflectionEnvs;
289
290 void ReleaseCubeArray();

336// Subset of FReflectionCaptureSortData, to support separate sorting of the key by itself.
337struct FReflectionCaptureSortKey
338{
339 FXxHash64 Guid;
340 float Radius;
341
342 bool operator<(const FReflectionCaptureSortKey& Other) const
343 {
344 if (Radius != Other.Radius)
345 {
346 return Radius < Other.Radius;
347 }
348 else
349 {
350 return Guid < Other.Guid;
351 }
352 }
353
354 bool operator!=(const FReflectionCaptureSortKey& Other) const
355 {
356 return Guid != Other.Guid || Radius != Other.Radius;
357 }
358};

633class FPrimitiveAndInstance
634{
635public:
636 FPrimitiveAndInstance(const FMatrix& InLocalToWorld, const FBox& InWorldBounds, FPrimitiveSceneInfo* InPrimitive, int32 InInstanceIndex)
637 : Primitive(InPrimitive)
638 , InstanceIndex(InInstanceIndex)
639 {
640 SetTransformAndBounds(InLocalToWorld, InWorldBounds);
641 }
642
643 FPrimitiveSceneInfo* Primitive;
644
645 FVector Origin;
646 FVector3f TransformRows[3];
647
648 FRenderBounds WorldBoundsRelativeToOrigin;
649
650 int32 InstanceIndex;
651
652 FORCEINLINE void SetTransformAndBounds(const FMatrix& InLocalToWorld, const FBox& InWorldBounds)
653 {
654 TransformRows[0] = FVector3f((float)InLocalToWorld.M[0][0], (float)InLocalToWorld.M[0][1], (float)InLocalToWorld.M[0][2]);
655 TransformRows[1] = FVector3f((float)InLocalToWorld.M[1][0], (float)InLocalToWorld.M[1][1], (float)InLocalToWorld.M[1][2]);
656 TransformRows[2] = FVector3f((float)InLocalToWorld.M[2][0], (float)InLocalToWorld.M[2][1], (float)InLocalToWorld.M[2][2]);
657 Origin = FVector(InLocalToWorld.M[3][0], InLocalToWorld.M[3][1], InLocalToWorld.M[3][2]);
658
659 WorldBoundsRelativeToOrigin = InWorldBounds.ShiftBy(-Origin);
660 }
661
662 FORCEINLINE FMatrix GetLocalToWorld() const
663 {
664 FMatrix Matrix;
665 Matrix.M[0][0] = TransformRows[0].X;
666 Matrix.M[0][1] = TransformRows[0].Y;
667 Matrix.M[0][2] = TransformRows[0].Z;
668 Matrix.M[0][3] = 0.0f;
669 Matrix.M[1][0] = TransformRows[1].X;
670 Matrix.M[1][1] = TransformRows[1].Y;
671 Matrix.M[1][2] = TransformRows[1].Z;
672 Matrix.M[1][3] = 0.0f;
673 Matrix.M[2][0] = TransformRows[2].X;
674 Matrix.M[2][1] = TransformRows[2].Y;
675 Matrix.M[2][2] = TransformRows[2].Z;
676 Matrix.M[2][3] = 0.0f;
677 Matrix.M[3][0] = Origin.X;
678 Matrix.M[3][1] = Origin.Y;
679 Matrix.M[3][2] = Origin.Z;
680 Matrix.M[3][3] = 1.0f;
681 return Matrix;
682 }
683
684 FORCEINLINE FBox GetWorldBounds() const
685 {
686 FBox WorldBoundsRelativeToOriginDoublePrecision = WorldBoundsRelativeToOrigin.ToBox();
687 return WorldBoundsRelativeToOriginDoublePrecision.ShiftBy(Origin);
688 }
689};

1275class FComponentVelocityData
1276{
1277public:
1278
1279 FPrimitiveSceneInfo* PrimitiveSceneInfo;
1280 FMatrix LocalToWorld;
1281 FMatrix PreviousLocalToWorld;
1282 mutable uint64 LastFrameUsed;
1283 uint64 LastFrameUpdated;
1284 bool bPreviousLocalToWorldValid = false;
1285};
1286
1290class FSceneVelocityData
1291{
1292public:
1293
1297 void StartFrame(FScene* Scene);
1298
1302 inline bool GetComponentPreviousLocalToWorld(FPrimitiveComponentId PrimitiveComponentId, FMatrix& OutPreviousLocalToWorld) const
1303 {
1304 const FComponentVelocityData* VelocityData = ComponentData.Find(PrimitiveComponentId);
1305
1306 if (VelocityData && VelocityData->PrimitiveSceneInfo)
1307 {
1308 check(VelocityData->bPreviousLocalToWorldValid);
1309 VelocityData->LastFrameUsed = InternalFrameIndex;
1310 OutPreviousLocalToWorld = VelocityData->PreviousLocalToWorld;
1311 return true;
1312 }
1313
1314 return false;
1315 }
1316
1321 const FMatrix* RESTRICT GetComponentPreviousLocalToWorld(FPrimitiveComponentId PrimitiveComponentId) const
1322 {
1323 const FComponentVelocityData* VelocityData = ComponentData.Find(PrimitiveComponentId);
1324
1325 if (VelocityData && VelocityData->PrimitiveSceneInfo)
1326 {
1327 check(VelocityData->bPreviousLocalToWorldValid);
1328 VelocityData->LastFrameUsed = InternalFrameIndex;
1329 return &VelocityData->PreviousLocalToWorld;
1330 }
1331
1332 return nullptr;
1333 }
1334
1338 void UpdateTransform(FPrimitiveSceneInfo* PrimitiveSceneInfo, const FMatrix& LocalToWorld, const FMatrix& PreviousLocalToWorld)
1339 {
1340 check(PrimitiveSceneInfo->Proxy->HasDynamicTransform());
1341
1342 FComponentVelocityData& VelocityData = ComponentData.FindOrAdd(PrimitiveSceneInfo->PrimitiveComponentId);
1343 VelocityData.LocalToWorld = LocalToWorld;
1344 VelocityData.LastFrameUsed = InternalFrameIndex;
1345 VelocityData.LastFrameUpdated = InternalFrameIndex;
1346 VelocityData.PrimitiveSceneInfo = PrimitiveSceneInfo;
1347
1348 // If this transform state is newly added, use the passed in PreviousLocalToWorld for this frame
1349 if (!VelocityData.bPreviousLocalToWorldValid)
1350 {
1351 VelocityData.PreviousLocalToWorld = PreviousLocalToWorld;
1352 VelocityData.bPreviousLocalToWorldValid = true;
1353 }
1354 }
1355
1356 void RemoveFromScene(FPrimitiveComponentId PrimitiveComponentId, bool bImmediate)
1357 {
1358 if (bImmediate)
1359 {
1360 ComponentData.Remove(PrimitiveComponentId);
1361 }
1362 else
1363 {
1364 FComponentVelocityData* VelocityData = ComponentData.Find(PrimitiveComponentId);
1365
1366 if (VelocityData)
1367 {
1368 VelocityData->PrimitiveSceneInfo = nullptr;
1369 }
1370 }
1371 }
1372
1376 void OverridePreviousTransform(FPrimitiveComponentId PrimitiveComponentId, const FMatrix& PreviousLocalToWorld)
1377 {
1378 FComponentVelocityData* VelocityData = ComponentData.Find(PrimitiveComponentId);
1379 if (VelocityData)
1380 {
1381 VelocityData->PreviousLocalToWorld = PreviousLocalToWorld;
1382 VelocityData->bPreviousLocalToWorldValid = true;
1383 }
1384 }
1385
1386 void ApplyOffset(FVector Offset)
1387 {
1388 for (TMap<FPrimitiveComponentId, FComponentVelocityData>::TIterator It(ComponentData); It; ++It)
1389 {
1390 FComponentVelocityData& VelocityData = It.Value();
1391 VelocityData.LocalToWorld.SetOrigin(VelocityData.LocalToWorld.GetOrigin() + Offset);
1392 VelocityData.PreviousLocalToWorld.SetOrigin(VelocityData.PreviousLocalToWorld.GetOrigin() + Offset);
1393 }
1394 }
1395
1396private:
1397
1398 uint64 InternalFrameIndex = 0;
1399 TMap<FPrimitiveComponentId, FComponentVelocityData> ComponentData;
1400};

2335 bool IsSecondAtmosphereLightEnabled()
2336 {
2337 // If the second light is not null then we enable the second light.
2338 // We do not do any light1 to light0 remapping if light0 is null.
2339 return AtmosphereLights[1] != nullptr;
2340 }
2341
2342 bool IsSecondAtmosphereLightEnabledForCloud()
2343 {
2344 if (IsSecondAtmosphereLightEnabled())
2345 {
2346 // Check the scattering scale of the second light to make sure it can contribute to the clouds before enabling it, as the second atmosphere light is an expensive feature.
2347 FLightSceneInfo* AtmosphericLight1Info = AtmosphereLights[1];
2348 FLightSceneProxy* AtmosphericLight1 = AtmosphericLight1Info ? AtmosphericLight1Info->Proxy : nullptr;
2349 if (AtmosphericLight1)
2350 {
2351 FLinearColor ColorScale = AtmosphericLight1->GetCloudScatteredLuminanceScale();
2352 if (ColorScale.R <= 0.0f && ColorScale.G <= 0.0f && ColorScale.B <= 0.0f)
2353 {
2354 return false;
2355 }
2356 return true;
2357 }
2358 }
2359 return false;
2360 }
